violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment  - Arranged for Supervision (26 TAC §747.4401(1))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment  - Arranged for Supervision
violation_type.typical_finding: The skirting under the deck allows for children to go underneath. A barrier needs to be installed.

finding_variants.text: The skirting under the deck allows for children to go underneath. A barrier needs to be installed.

The new playground structure on the playground did not meet the required safety requirements for the tire swing, bucket swings, and rope swing. This was corrected during the inspection by the provider creating a safety plan to ensure the play structure will not be used during operation hours. The play structure will be used after hours only.
